test_empty_duration: test the pl.duration function with an empty dataframe and verify it returns a Duration column
test_duration_time_units: test pl.duration with different time units (ms, us, ns) and verify correct timedelta values
test_datetime_duration_offset: test adding and subtracting duration offsets to datetime columns in a polars dataframe
test_date_duration_offset: test adding and subtracting duration offsets to date columns in a polars dataframe
test_duration_wildcard_expansion: test pl.duration with wildcard column expansion using pl.all() to create durations from multiple columns
